verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robot simulator with remote, socket-based interfaces through Gazebo Transport, so access control over who can command, configure, or view simulated robots is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no roles, permissions, authentication, or per-robot access policies. Transport, GUI, and CLI features are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can control with roles and permissions who is allowed to command, configure, or view each robot
